title: Draft: V2G Transfer protocol dissector.
description:
This dissector dissects V2GTP messages and hands of to a v2gmsg, 'dissector if present.

dSPACE provides a dissector at https://github.com/dspace-group/dsV2Gshark,
If the files v2gmsg.lua v2gcommon.lua and v2gLib_54.dll from their plugin is placed in the,
plugins directory complete dissection is achived.

Example trace files at https://github.com/dspace-group/dsV2Gshark/tree/main/Wireshark/dsV2Gshark_examples

AI-Assisted: no

Hi,

just a general note: As discussed in a related [issue on GitHub](https://github.com/dspace-group/dsV2Gshark/issues/49#issuecomment-4443793431), this new dissector works in general. However, in its current state, its practical benefit is limited because the underlying layer still needs to be dissected to display any useful data.

The current implementation may also introduce compatibility issues with existing third-party plugins, which are currently widely used in the EV charging domain.
